# `schema-depth`

**Tool rule** · `warning` · on by default

Deeply nested input schemas are hard for small models to fill.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Options

| Option | Default |
| ------ | ------- |
| `max`  | `3`     |

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "schema-depth": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "schema-depth": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "schema-depth": { max: 3 } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule schema-depth=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/schema-depth": "error" } }
```
